purpose: Teach: 玲子/聖子/茜/秀雄/浅田/川端/吉本/細田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご親戚の玲子さんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, didn't Father used to correspond with your cousin Reiko?
lines.style: Gentle, almost uncertain. Soft nostalgia with a questioning lilt at the end. Speaking into memory, not demanding confirmation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、松田聖子のヒット曲を口ずさまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Well, you know, dear — when you were young, you used to hum that Matsuda Seiko hit song all the time, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, playful redirect. A teasing lilt underneath. She's turning the mirror back on him gently, with affection baked in.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが姪の茜さんを可愛がられた
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, Father was very fond of our niece Akane, wasn't he?
lines.style: Softer than before. Less interrogative, more reflective. A small pause before the question—like he's offering her a memory to hold.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご友人の秀雄さんとお酒を酌み交わされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Now dear, when you were young, you used to share a drink with your friend Hideo all the time, didn't you?
lines.style: Knowing warmth. Patient tease. She's matching his rhythm exactly, but with her own sweetness. A nudge forward in the dance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが浅田次郎の小説を蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, Father collected novels by Asada Jiro, didn't he?
lines.style: Voice fading slightly into time. Wistful, but there's acceptance in it now. Speaking as if to the memory itself, not just to her.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、川端康成のノーベル受賞のニュースを観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Well, you know — when you were young, you saw the news about Kawabata winning the Nobel Prize, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright, alive with shared history. She's matching his nostalgia but pulling them both forward gently. A fond, genuine smile underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが吉本興業の劇場に通われた
lines.en: Gran, when you were young, Father used to go to the Yoshimoto Kogyo theater regularly, didn't he?
lines.style: Voice carrying real tenderness now. Each word deliberate. Like he's placing down small stones of memory, one by one.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、細田守監督の作品をお孫様と楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and you used to enjoy Hosoda Mamoru films with the grandchildren back then, remember, dear?
lines.style: Warm, intimate close. A soft smile in her voice. She knows exactly where this is going and loves him for it. Trailing gently into companionable silence.
